senses.gloss:
m. (-ङ्कः)
A draft ox.
f. (-ङ्का)
1 Fear, terror, apprehension.
2 Doubt, uncertainty.
3 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre.
E.
शकि to fear, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Doubtful, questionable, to be doubted or apprehended.
E.
शकि to fear or doubt, अनीयर् aff.; also शङ्कितव्य and शङ्क्य.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness or good fortune.
m. (-रः)
1 ŚIVA.
2 The name of a celebrated teacher of the Vedānta philosophy.
f. (-री)
Bengal madder.
E.
शं good fortune, कर making.

m. (-रः)
A bull.
n. (-रं)
A form of metre.
E.
शङ्कर ŚIVA, and अण् aff.; also read शाक्कर.

m. (-रः)
1 Mixing, blending, confounding.
2 A mixed caste or race, one proceeding from the promiscuous intercourse of the four tribes in the first instance, and again from their commerce with the descendants of such a connexion, or the indiscriminate cohabitation of those descendants amongst one another: most Hindus of the present age are of one of the many branches of this race, the highest of which is impure and inferior to the Śūdra: under this term two kinds of men are included according to the Rāmāyaṇa; the one denominated योनिसङ्कर, mixed or degraded by birth; and आचारसङ्कर degraded by conduct.
3 Dust, sweepings.
4 The crackling of flame.
E.
सम् before कॄ to scatter, or कृ to make, aff. अप्.

m. (-रः)
1 Dust, sweepings.
2 The crackling of flame.
f. (-री)
A girl recently deflowered, a new bride, &c.
E.
सम् before कृ to make, अण् aff.

m. (-यः)
The francoline partridge.
E.
शङ्कर ŚIVA, and प्रिय dear, beloved.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Apprehensive, doubtful, afraid.
E.
शङ्का, अन्वित possessed of.

m. (-गः)
Accusation or charge on suspicion.
E.
शङ्का, and अभियोग charge.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Fearful, afraid.
E.
शङ्का, and मयट् aff.

n. (-दं)
Cause or matter of doubt or apprehension.
E.
शङ्का, and आस्पद site.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Free from doubt or apprehension.
E.
शङ्का, and हीन free from.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Alarmed, frightened.
2 Weak, unsteady.
3 Doubtful, uncertain.
E.
शङ्का fear, इतच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A thief.
E.
शङ्कित frightened, वर्ण a caste, कन् aff.

m. (-ङ्कुः)
1 The trunk of a lopped tree.
2 A javelin.
3 A pin, a stake, a pale.
4 The gnomon of a dial, usually twelve fingers long.
5 A long thin column in front of a pagoda.
6 The penis.
7 A number.
8 The small fibres of a leaf.
9 The scate fish, (Raia Sankur, HAM.)
10 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi.
11 A goose.
12 An ant hill.
13 A goblin, a demon.
14 A Gandharba attached to ŚIVA.
15 A name of ŚIVA.
16 KĀMA.
17 Sin.
18 Fear, terror.
E.
शकि to doubt or apprehend, aff. उ.

m. (-ङ्कुः)
A hole.

m. (-र्णः)
An ass.
E.
शङ्कु a javelin, and कर्ण the ear.

m. (-चिः)
A scate fish.

f. (-ची)
The scate fish; also शंकुची, &c.

m. (-रुः)
The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
शङ्कु a stake, and तरु a tree.

m. (-क्षः)
The Śāl tree.
E.
शङ्कु a pin or stake, and वृक्ष tree.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Formidable, fearful, frightful.
E.
शङ्कु fear, रा to give or cause, aff. ड.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Budding, in bud.
E.
स with, अङ्कुर a bud.

f. (-ला)
A pair of nippers, used to cut the betel nut into small pieces.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Crowded, confused, filled with so as to be impervious.
n. (-लं)
1 Inconsistent and contradictory speech.
2 War.
3 A crowd, a mob.
4 A flock, a flight.
E.
सम् together, कुल to accumulate, aff. क.

m. (-चः)
A scate fish; also शङ्कु, शङ्कुचि, and शङ्कोचि.

m. (-चः)
1 Shutting, closing, contracting, contraction.
2 Binding, tying.
3 A sort of fish, a scate, (Raia Sancura, HAM.)
n. (-त्रं)
Saffron.
E.
सम् before कुच to contract, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं)
To be feared or doubted.
E.
शकि to fear. यत् aff.

mn. (-ङ्खः-ङ्खं)
The conch shell used by the Hindus, in two ways especially; offering libations with it, or when perforated at one end blowing it as a horn at sacrifices: used in this manner also, frequent, mention of it occurs in the battle pieces of the poets, each hero being provided with a Conch as his horn.
m. (-ङ्खः)
1 One of KUVERA'S treasures.
2 The temple or temporal bone, sometimes comprising however the frontal bone also.
3 A perfume, commonly Nakhi, apparently a dried shell fish.
4 A military drum.
5 One of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla, described as of a yellow colour.
6 An elephant's cheek.
7 A large number, ten or a hundred billions.
8 The name of a saint and legislator.
9 A poet, one of the nine gems, &c.
E.
शम to pacify, &c. Uṇādi aff. ख.

n. (-ङ्खं)
The sound of the conch shell.
E.
शङ्ख the shell, and अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
A bracelet, (often made of the conch shell.)
mn. (-कः-कं)
1 The conch shell.
2 Pain, and heat with a puffiness in the temples and forehead.
3 The temples.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-रः)
A worker in shells.
E.
शङ्ख a conch, and कार maker.

f. (-री)
Sandal marks on the forehead.
E.
शङ्ख the forehead, and चर to go, aff. टच् and ङीष्.

f. (-र्च्ची)
Sandal marks made across the forehead.
E.
शङ्ख the forehead, चर्च to anoint, affs. अच् and ङीष्.

m. (-जः)
A large pearl, of the shape of a pigeon's egg.
E.
शङ्ख a shell, and ज born.

m. (-ध्मः)
A shell blower.
E.
शङ्ख a conch, and घ्म who blows.

m. (-खः)
1 A small shell.
2 A perfume, commonly नखी.
E.
शङ्ख a conch, and नख the nail.

m. (-लः)
1 The sun.
2 A Nāga or serpent of Pātāla.
E.
शङ्ख a conch, &c., and पाल who nourishes.

f. (-ष्पी)
A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.)
E.
शङ्ख a conch, पुष्प a flower, ङीप् aff. implying resemblance.

m. (-स्थः)
Spots in the moon.
E.
शङ्ख a shell, and प्रस्थ pre-eminent.

mfn. (-भृत्)
Having a conch or shell.
m. (-भृत्)
VIṢṆU.
E.
शङ्ख a conch, and भृत् who possesses.

m. (-खः)
An alligator.
E.
शङ्ख a conch, and मुख face.

f. (-का)
A kind of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.)
E.
शंख a shell, कन् implying resemblance, fem. form.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Made from, relating to, &c. the Śaṅkha or conch.
m. (-कः)
1 A shell cutter, a worker in shells.
2 A player on the Śaṅkha, a shell blower.
E.
शङ्ख the conch shell, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्खी-ङ्खिनी-ङ्खि)
Possessing or having a conch or shell, &c.
m. (-ङ्खी)
1 VIṢṆU.
2 The ocean.
3 A shell blower.
4 A worker in shells.
f. (-नी)
1 A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.)
2 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
3 A description of woman, one of the four classes into which females are divided in erotic writings: the Śaṅkhinī is described as tall, with long hair, neither stout nor thin, of irascible disposition and strong passions.
4 A goddess or Śakti worshipped by the Bauddhas.
5 A female spirit or goblin.
E.
शङ्ख a shell, इनि aff.

m. (-सः)
A small tree, (Trophis aspera.)

m. (-रिः)
1 KĀRTTIKEYA.
2 GAṆEŚA.
3 Fire.
4 A Muni.
E.
शङ्कर ŚIVA, and इञ् patronymic aff.

f. (-ष्ठा)
A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.)

n. (-वं)
A yoke of six oxen, or six oxen collectively.
E.
षष् six, and गो an ox, अच् added.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Narrow, contracted.
2 Crowded.
3 Impassable, impervious.
n. (-टं)
1 Difficulty, trouble.
2 A defile, a pass.
E.
सम् before कटच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Winking, leering.
m. (-क्षः)
A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)
E.
सङ्कट contracted, अक्षि the eye.

f. (-था)
Conversation, discourse, talking together.
E.
सम् together, कथा speech; also सङ्कथन, &c.

n. (-णं)
1 Reducing to the state of the mixed or outcaste tribes, causing loss of caste.
2 Blending, mixing.
3 Confusion, either in kind, number, or arrangement.
E.
सङ्कर a mixed race, च्चि augment, and करण doing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blended, mixed, confusedly.
2 Outcaste.
E.
सङ्कर, and कृत made, च्चि aug.

n. (-णं)
1 Attracting, drawing.
2 Ploughing, making furrows, &c.
m. (-णः)
BALADEVA.
E.
सम् before कृष to plough. [] &c., aff. युच् or ल्युट्. As applied to the demigod it refers to his removal in embryo from the womb of DEVAKĪ to that of ROHIṆĪ.

m. (-लः)
1 Collection, quantity.
2 Addition.
E.
सम् together, कल to number, aff. अच्.

aptote.
Killing, slaughter.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Effected or produced by addition, collection, &c.
E.
सङ्कल collection, aff. अञ्.

nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Contact, junction.
2 Blending, clinging, twining, intermixture.
3 Heaping as corn, &c.
n. (-नं)
Addition, (in arithmetic.)
E.
सम् with or like, कल to number, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Heaped, piled, arranged.
2 Brought in contact, blended, intermixed.
3 Added.
n. (-तं)
Addition, (in arithmetic.)
E.
सम् before कल to number, aff. क्त.

m. (-ल्पः)
1 Volition, will, resolve, mental determination.
2 A solemn vow or declaration of purpose.
3 Expectation of desired consequences from any voluntary act.
E.
सम् before कृप to be able, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born of, or proceeding from the hope or expectation of advantage.
m. (-जः)
KĀMA or love.
E.
सङ्कल्प, and ज born; also सङ्कल्पजन्मन्, &c.

m. (-न्मा)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
सङ्कल्प volition, and जन्मन् birth.

m. (वः)
KĀMA.
E.
सङ्कल्प will, and भव born.

m. (-निः)
KĀMA, the deity of love.
E.
सङ्कल्प will, and योनि place of birth.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Of the nature of or conformable to the will or purpose.
E.
सङ्कल्प, and रूप form.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced from or arising out of the hope or desire of advantage.
m. (-वः)
Love or KĀMA.
E.
सङ्कल्प, and सम्भव birth.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Willing, resolving, referring to volition.
E.
सङ्कल्प, and आत्मक one with.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Proposed, sought as the result of any act.
E.
सङ्कल्प, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Unsteady, fickle, changeable.
2 Uncertain, doubtful.
3 Weak, feeble.
4 Bad, weak, wicked.
E.
सम् before कस to go, Uṇādi aff. उकन्.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Like, similar, (in composition.)
2 Near.
E.
सम् before काशृ to shine, aff. अच्.

m. (-लः)
A burning torch, a fire-brand.
E.
सम् before किल to be white, aff. क.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Crowded, confused.
2 Miscellaneous.
3 Impure.
4 Mixed.
5 Of mixed and consequently impure origin or caste.
6 Contracted, narrow.
7 Spread, diffused.
8 Scattered.
9 Indistinct, confused, (as a writing.)
E.
सम् before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wandering about, going into all sorts of places.
E.
सङ्कीर्ण, and चारिन् who goes.

mfn. (-निः-निः-नि)
Of mixed or impure origin.
E.
सङ्कीर्ण, and योनि place of birth.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Celebrating, praising, honour, glorification.
E.
सम् before कॄत to praise, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised, renowned, celebrated.
E.
सम् intensitive, कॄत to praise, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unblown, unopened.
2 Closed, shut.
3 Narrowed, contracted.
E.
सम् before कुच to contract, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
A form of metre, a stanza of four lines, of 24 syllables each.
E.
सम् complete, कृति a metre.

r. 10th cl. (सङ्केतयति)
1 To call or invite.
2 To counsel or advise.
3 To fix or appoint a time.

m. (-तः)
1 Engagement, agreement, appointment, convention.
2 Condition, provision, the circumstances under which any thing is necessarily or naturally effected.
3 Sign, gesture, gesticulation.
E.
सङ्केत to appoint a time, &c., aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
Place of assignation.
E.
सङ्केत, and स्थान place.

n. (-नं)
Astringing, causing to shrink or close.
E.
मम्, कुच to contract, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

m. (-नः)
INDRA.
E.
सम् before क्रदि to cry out, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mn. (-मः-मं)
1 Difficult progress, clambering up rocks, fording torrents, making way through almost impervious or inaccessible passes, &c.
2 The means of effecting such a passage, a causeway, a bridge, &c.
m. (-मः)
1 Going, moving, travelling.
2 The passage of a planetary body through the zodiac.
3 Passage from one point to another, traversing, transit, transition.
4 Concurrence.
E.
सम् before क्रम to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-मः)
1 Difficult progress or passage over steep rocks, through narrow defiles, &c.
2 A bridge of ropes, &c.: see सङ्क्रम.
E.
सम् before क्रम to go, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Going from or to, passage, transition.
2 Going with, concurrence.
E.
सम्, and क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.: see the last.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who goes or proceeds, who or what passes from one to another.
E.
सम्, क्रम to go, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Passed, gone from one to another, transferred, &c.
2 Entered (into a new sign).
3 Depicted, imaged, reflected.
E.
सम् before क्रम to go, aff. क्त.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 The actual passage of the sun or other planetary bodies from one sign of the zodiac into another.
2 Passage in general, proceeding from one time or condition of life to another, from one place to another, &c.
3 Going, proceeding in general.
4 Imitation, reflexion.
E.
सम् before क्रम to go, aff. क्तिन्.

n. (-णं)
Sporting, playing.
E.
सम् before क्रीड to play, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Sporting, playing.
E.
सम् before क्रीड to play, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Violent, enraged.
E.
सम्, and क्रुद्ध angry.

m. (-दः)
1 The fluid secretion which is supposed to form upon conception, and to be the rudiment of the foetus.
2 Moisture, wet, damp.
E.
सम् to gether, and क्लेद moisture.

m. (-यः)
1 The destruction of the world.
2 Loss, destruction in general.
E.
सम् completely, क्षि to perish, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Abridged, abbreviated, concise, compressed.
2 Small, compact.
3 Thrown.
4 Sent.
5 Taken from or away, seized.
E.
सम् before क्षिप to throw or send, aff. क्त.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Abridgment.
2 Throwing.
3 Sending.
4 Ambuscade.
5 Transition from one feeling to another.
E.
सम्, क्षिप to throw, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Perishing, being destroyed.
E.
सम् before क्षि to waste, शानच् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 Abridgment, abbreviation, conciseness, compression.
2 Sending.
3 Throwing.
4 Taking away.
5 Assisting in another's duty.
E.
सम् before क्षिप to throw or send, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Abridgment, brevity.
2 Sending.
3 Throwing.
4 Taking away.
E.
सम् before क्षिप to throw or send, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-भः)
1 Overturning, upsetting.
2 Shaking, trembling, agitation.
3 Pride, arrogance.
E.
सम् before क्षुभ to tremble, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Whetting, sharpening.
2 Inflaming, exciting.
E.
सम् before क्ष्णु to sharpen, शानच् aff.

n. (-ङ्ख्यं)
War, battle.
f. (-ङ्ख्या)
1 Number in general, or a number, a numeral.
2 Deliberation, reasoning, reflection.
3 Intellect, understanding.
E.
सम् before ख्या substituted for चक्ष to speak well, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्यी-ङ्ख्यं)
1 Numeral, relating to number.
2 Rational, discriminative.
m. (-ङ्ख्यः)
The Sāṃkhya system of philosophy, ascribed originally to the Muni KAPILA.
E.
संख्या number, &c., and अण् aff.

f. (-ता)
Number, numeration, counting.
E.
तल् added to the last; also सङ्ख्यत्व.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Numbered, counted, reckoned.
E.
सम् before ख्या to tell, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
Numbering, numeration, reckoning.
E.
सम् before ख्या to tell, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Having or being possessed of number, numbered.
2 Intelligent, discriminating.
m. (-वान्)
A learned Brahman, a Paṇḍita, a teacher.
E.
सङ्ख्या number, &c., and मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Numerable, to be counted or numbered.
E.
सङ्ख्या a number, यत् aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Meeting, encountering.
2 Association, intercourse, friendship.
3 Joining, uniting.
4 Desire, wish, cupidity.
5 Addiction or devotion to.
6 Confluence of rivers.
E.
सम् together, गम to go, aff. ड, or षंज to embrace. घञ् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
1 Having all the members.
2 Comprising all the subdivisions.
E.
स with, अङ्ग a limb or part.

f. (-का)
Incomparable or unequalled discourse.
E.
सम् before गण to count, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Apposite, proper, (as speech.)
2 Mixed, united.
3 Met, encountered.
4 Collected, accumulated.
5 In conjunction, (planets.)
n. (-तं)
1 Friendship, acquaintance.
2 Union, meeting.
E.
सम् before गत gone.

f. (-तिः)
1 Meeting, union, mixture.
2 Knowledge.
3 Association, intercourse.
4 Frequenting, going to.
5 Questioning for continued or further information.
E.
सम् together, गति going.

m. (-मः)
1 Meeting, union, mixture, junction, the encounter of persons, the association of friends or lovers, the confluence of rivers, the fitness or adaptation of two things to each other, &c.
2 (In astronomy,) Planetary conjunction.
E.
सम् together, like, suitably, गम going: see also सङ्ग, सङ्गत, सङ्गति, &c.

m. (-मः)
Union, meeting.
E.
सङ्गम the same, अण् pleonasm.

m. (-रः)
1 War, battle.
2 Misfortune, calamity.
3 Promise, assent, agreement.
4 A bargain, a transaction of sale.
5 Poison.
6 Knowledge.
n. (-रं)
The fruit of the Śami tree.
E.
सम् before गॄ to swallow, aff. अप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Indifferent, stoical, free from attachment.
E.
सङ्ग, and रहित free from.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Free from worldly attachments or affections.
E.
सङ्ग, and वर्ज्जित abandoned.

f. (-तिः)
1 Separation from, or dissolution of worldly affection.
2 Disunion.
E.
